NAME: Sign-in is not attendance
INVARIANT: Present requires successful clock-in and clock-out.

NAME: Actual print material use
INVARIANT: Complete requires actual material usage and QC evidence.

NAME: Actual bakery yield
INVARIANT: Completion requires nonnegative actual yield; expected yield is never substituted.

NAME: Loaf and money reconciliation
INVARIANT: Unexplained quantity or cash variance blocks reconciliation.

NAME: Proof of delivery
INVARIANT: A trip cannot be delivered or closed without POD evidence.

NAME: Maker-checker decisions
INVARIANT: Maker cannot approve their own controlled request; decision reason is required.

NAME: Balanced journal
INVARIANT: Posting requires finite equal debit and credit values in an open period.

NAME: Commitment recognition
INVARIANT: Approval alone creates no active commitment. Ordered and partial-received balances do.

NAME: Receipt accountability
INVARIANT: Accepted plus rejected quantity equals delivered quantity.

NAME: Human publication approval
INVARIANT: Human approval and explicit Publish permission precede any simulated publication.

NAME: Zero disclosure
INVARIANT: No assignment means no disclosure; missing and unauthorized resources share a neutral result.

NAME: Specialized permission
INVARIANT: Export, Pay, Publish and other specialized actions are explicit, never implied by a level.

NAME: Config safety
INVARIANT: No arbitrary SQL/JavaScript; protected business invariants cannot be disabled.

NAME: Stock custody
INVARIANT: Transfer closure requires received quantity equal to dispatched quantity.

NAME: Borrowed stock
INVARIANT: Closure requires the full issued quantity returned.

NAME: Payroll readiness
INVARIANT: Net pay, bank validation, statutory configuration and approval are separate gates.

NAME: Authoritative communication events
INVARIANT: Opening a screen never sends a message; sends require an authorized event or an approved manual flow with idempotency, consent and audit.

NAME: Human communication approval
INVARIANT: AI may draft, but a manually initiated customer communication follows Generate, Preview, Edit, Approve, Send.

NAME: Server-side provider authority
INVARIANT: Provider credentials, signatures, webhook verification and retries belong in production server-side adapters, never the frontend.

NAME: Verified payment activation
INVARIANT: A bank notification alone cannot activate service; verified provider event, match, authoritative payment state and applicable business rule are all required.

NAME: Transfer separation of duties
INVARIANT: Create, approve, execute and reconcile are separate grants; a maker cannot approve their own controlled transfer.

NAME: Payroll finality
INVARIANT: Batch submission does not mark employees paid; success or reversal is applied per employee and reconciled before final state.

NAME: Financial account zero disclosure
INVARIANT: Unassigned accounts, balances, transactions, beneficiaries, payroll batches, reports and their derived counts are absent from every surface.
